model_annotation: This pie chart, labeled B4, presents responses to a survey question in Bulgarian asking to what extent respondents agree with the statement "Design is well integrated in the product development process in our organization." The chart contains five slices representing different levels of agreement. The largest slice, shown in green, represents "Добре е интегриран" (Well integrated) with a value of 25. The second largest slice, depicted in orange, corresponds to "Много добре е интегриран" (Very well integrated) with a value of 24. A purple slice represents "Не е интегриран такъв подход" (Such an approach is not integrated) with a value of 20. A blue slice represents "Изцяло е интегриран" (Fully integrated) with a value of 10, and the smallest slice, shown in red, corresponds to "Слабо е интегриран" (Weakly integrated) with a value of 8. The total of all values sums to 87, and the numerical values appear to represent counts or percentages displayed alongside a legend positioned to the left of the chart. The legend uses colored circles matching each slice's color paired with the corresponding category label and numerical value. No percentage labels appear inside the slices themselves, and none of the slices appear to be visually exploded or offset from the chart. The slices are not arranged in strictly descending order by size within the chart.
